response.sql:
SELECT AVG(media_avg_bytes_per_ms)
FROM (
  SELECT mt.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS media_avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
) AS per_media_type

assumptions.assumption: Each media type with at least one qualifying track contributes one average; the outer AVG is over those media types, and division uses floating-point arithmetic.
